Name: Expressive leverage
Description:
The ability to accomplish more by expressing less.
"... achieved when a tool reduces the total number of choices that a designer must make to express a desired solution."

Name: Flexibility
Description: The ability to make rapid design changes and evaluation of such changes
How to claim/evaluate: "Define some interesting and diverse set of possible design changes and show that such changes take significantly less effort in the new tool relative to the competition"

Name: Expressive match
Description: How close the means for expressing design choices are to the problem being solved.
How to claim/evaluate:
"If the problems are small enough one can compare times to create a design or express a set of choices"
"Frequently greater expressive match is tied to a claim to lower skill barrier"
